forum.title: STMCubeMX2 shows only STM32C devices
forum.best_answer_content:
Yes, that is the expected behaviour:

<https://community.st.com/stm32-software-tools-165/introducing-stm32cubemx2-a-new-flavor-of-stm32cubemx-tool-163780>

“STM32CubeMX2 is introduced for new STM32 series, starting with [**STM32C5**](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32c5-series.html?ecmp=tt48495_gl_link_mar2026).”

Older series remain on “original” MX

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/16b485e6-36b4-44af-af49-2b48e150ca12.png)

<https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html>
